rulesAndGuidelines.title: Floof Squad Community Rules and Guidelines
rulesAndGuidelines.header: Thank you for your patience and listening to our rules, if you have any suggestions or feel something is missing, dont hesitate to bring it up with any avaliable member of staff!

items.title: Respect each other
items.description:
No harassment, hate or discrimination:
Any racism, sexism, disrespect, or any of that stuff toward anyone, regardless of if they are a member of staff or another member is prohibited and disallowed. There is space for jokes and a bit of banter, but when someone tells you to stop, you stop.
  
Keep debates respectful:
Disagreement with someone's point of view, opinion, or take on a certain topic is fine; being hostile or combative about it isn't.
Let a member of staff know if you arent comfortable with what a user has said.

Respect staff decisions:
If you are questioning staff decisions or actions, please, let us know. Whether you bring it up publicly or privately, your opinion matters, but keep it respectful;
Public arguments aren't helpful, if it's a serious matter, bring it up privately. ^^

items.title: Don't be disruptive
items.description:
No spamming or flooding chats:
Avoid excessive pinging, sending repeated messages in quick succession, sending massive texts in one message, and sending abusive copypastas.

Try to stay on topic in each channel:
Read the channel descriptions - keep conversations in their dedicated thread so they can live in a place where they belong.

No trolling or ragebaiting:
Trying to stir up drama or get a rise out of others, staff member or not, for any reason will be met with appropriate punishment.
Let's keep it respectful here.

items.title: Keep the server safe and appropriate.
items.description:
No NSFW content:
This server includes both minors, and adults, so it is common sense that any NSFW content of any form is prohibited. This includes explicit jokes, media or overly suggestive usernames.

No unsolicited ads or self-promo:
Don't drop links or promos to any other discord server outside of DMs. Unless there is a thread where said content is allowed to be posted, leave it out of our server.

Follow Discord's Terms of Services and community guidelines:
No underage accounts , illegal activity, or ban-dodging.
Discord TOS: https://discord.com/terms
Discord Community guidelines: https://discord.com/guidelines/

items.title: Sexual content
items.description:
Avoid sharing sexual jokes, stories, or innuendos regardless of how old you both are. Save that for the DMs.

Keep discussions appropriate for a general audience and age range.

Respect others' comfort levels at all times, when someone isnt comfortable with what you are saying, you drop the subject immediately, regardless of if you are a member of staff or not.

items.title: Use common sense and proper judgement.
items.description:
Use respectful nicknames:
Nicknames referencing content that is not permitted on this server is prohibited, no room for discussion, how you present yourself is important, as if you have an overly racist display name, and you proceed to get offended when youre labelled as racist, or are warned/punished for ignoring this rule, thats your own fault. There is no excuse.

Keep avatars and bios appropriate:
No graphic or offensive content in visible profile elements. Same reasoning as the rule above.

items.title: Have fun, be a good crew member!
items.description:
Welcome new members:
Greet them, help them get settled, and invite them to join in, and treat them as if you would expect to be treated when you first join a server like our own.

Be playful, not harmful:
Jokes and teasing are fine, just don't cross the line. While we have rules prohibiting certain jokes, these are only really punishable if you go too far.
Dark humour and the likes are allowed as long as they remain jokes that everyone finds funny. The second people start to express discomfort at jokes like this is where it stops, no questions asked, respect people's comfortability.

items.title: Public venting
items.description:
Public Venting:
To keep this space safe and comfy for everyone public venting is not allowed, and is advised to be either be left exclusively in its dedicated thread, or outside the server with someone you trust.

If you desperately need help consider Talking to close friends or people you trust in your DM's, family or friendgroup. You are not alone, and if needs be, the staff are always happy to listen to you and provide some much needed solace.

items.title: Politics
items.description:
If political topics must be discussed, since trigger warnings do basically nothing, please at least put it in the dedicated
#political-talk thread, which only people with a dedicated role will have access to. This is said as some people may find politics uncomfortable, and may not want to hear about it. Political talk is okay as long as it stays respectful, in line with our rules, and doesnt offend anyone.

items.title: Addictive substances
items.description: If substances like Alcohol / Marijuana etc ... are mentioned we advise  you to put TW (Trigger Warning) Infront of the message so people who have had bad experiences with these substances dont have to be confronted with this topic directly, and so, they dont have to read messages like this if they dont want to.

items.title: Venting
items.description:
This is a difficult subject for me to explain.
We have a rule that states public venting should be taken elsewhere, however, a channel now exists. A specific role has been added that gives people with that role and ***ONLY*** people with that role access to the thread. ***ANY*** abuse of that thread ***WILL*** be punished. It is intened as a place for people to vent and let go of any emotions that are troubling them.
Abuse includes bullying, shitposting, judging or anything else that is not either an attempt at giving support or your own venting. The staff will have access to the thread, as such, offending staff will also be punished for breaking this rule.

Penalties, consequences and punishments.title: Listed rules and their attatched punishments
Penalties, consequences and punishments.header: This is a list of the punishments that can be handed out if you break the rules of the server.

items.title: Punishments:
items.description:
Breaking the rules can result in the following, depending on the severity:

Basic rulebreak:
1st offence: Being warned
2nd or 3rd offence: Verbal warning from a staff member

Deliberate disregard for rules:
If warnings are not enough, you may be timed out.
4th offence: 30 minute timeout
5th offence: 1 hour timeout
6th offence: 24 hour timeout

Final chance:
7th offence: If being timed out didnt teach you a lesson, you may be kicked from the server with the opportunity to reapply.

Nuclear option.
8th offence: If kicking you hasnt taught you that maybe what you're doing needs to stop, you may face a total ban from the server, no questions asked. You had your chances.

Note no one is exempt from punishment. Anyone who is caught breaking our community rules can be punished, meaning even staff members are not excused.
These punishments are flexible, and can and will be handed out out of order depending on how severely you are breaking the rules.

items.title: Regarding challenging staff decisions.
items.description:
Any decisions made by staff are always open for disagreement or debate.
If you or someone else have recieved a punishment that you feel was unworthy or unfair, feel free to challenge the staff member who made the decision.
Note other staff are permitted to join these debates.
If this is necessary, keep it respectful.
The second it becomes toxic, the second the argument becomes void and you are punished for turning a friendly debate hostile. 
We are not slaves nor punching bags.
We are here to keep your community safe and friendly, please show some respect. 
Disrespect toward the owner or any of her staff will not be tolerated if it becomes actively hostile.
This is not to say you cannot be upset by action taken, just be respectful with it.
